title: The Mirror Pair Canon
summary: A canon of the mirror pair in which a hostile soul force and its twin opposite are set side by side until both are gone.

title: Treatise of the Twin Quiet
summary: A treatise on the twin quiet that a nullifier holds in two places at once so that one cancels the strike and the other the echo.

title: The Hawk's Perfect Stillness
summary: A manual of the hawk poised in perfect stillness high above the field and falling in silence on any hostile soul technique that rises.

title: Canon of the Dual-Track Silence
summary: A canon of silence run on two tracks at once so that a hostile technique is cancelled in its form and again in its echo.

title: The Wind-Sworn Quiet Canon
summary: A canon of the quiet sworn on the wind in which the nullifier stands in the open and lets hostile soul force blow past and fade.

title: Treatise of the Sworn Null
summary: A treatise on the null sworn by a company before battle and held by each member until the last hostile soul note has died.

title: The Bearing Stillness Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of stillness taken by bearing so that a nullifier knows the heading of every hostile force and holds it dead.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Quiet
summary: A canon of the open quiet that hides behind no cover and spreads over the field until no hostile soul force can sound.
